what: The center's own site lists two exhibitions that opened on 7 November 2026 and run into February 2027, and gives weekly opening hours.

ORF Wien reported on 11 June 2025 that the Kunstforum would close its house on the Freyung on 31 August 2025 and that Bank Austria no longer wanted to run an exhibition house. The director spoke of a new Kunstforum project at another place, and no page found shows that it opened.
quote: mit 31. August den Standort auf der Wiener Freyung schließen

also.what: Der Standard, summer 2025, says the house has to close for good at the end of August and hand the building over empty on 31 August.

what: InDaily reported on 12 March 2026 that Tandanya hosted the Gluttony programme of the Adelaide Fringe in February and March 2026 after more than two years shut for repairs. Its own site says it is not open for daily access and is preparing a relaunch in 2027.
quote: the site is set to reopen with a bang

also.what: Own site: "We are not currently open for public programming or daily access" and "Tandanya is preparing for its relaunch in 2027."

what: Cadena 3 reported on 30 May 2026 that the museum reopened in Xochimilco after being shut for almost six years. The address in the record, museodolores.mx, did not resolve.
quote: ha reabierto sus puertas tras un cierre de casi seis años

what: The museum has shown no exhibitions since December 2024 and its site calls it temporarily closed. Its press release of 18 March 2026 says it will sell its building and keeps booking hired events there through January 2027. No page says it has closed for good.
quote: The CJM will continue to book new events through January 2027.

also.what: The San Francisco Standard, 1 October 2026: the museum closed in 2024 for at least a year, "It has not reopened", and it is selling the building while it seeks a new home.

what: Het HEM announced on 17 June 2024 that the owner Amerborgh had decided to end its activities in the former munitions factory in Zaandam, with all activities stopping by 1 August 2024. It said it was looking at a move to Amsterdam, and no page found shows a new home. Its site still carries the banner that Het HEM is closed.
quote: All activities will stop by the 1st of August.

also.what: Home page banner reads "Het HEM is closed"; the latest events listed are dated 6 and 7 July 2024.

what: The Sandy Times, 30 August 2026, says Townhouse closed in 2019 after 21 years, and that Access Art Space opened in the same building in 2020, run by members of the former Townhouse team as a separate space.

also.what: Contemporary And, 15 September 2020: the space was handed over in June 2019 and the legal papers for the closure were completed then; no decision on a new form had been announced.
SceneNow, 11 February 2026: the successor Access Art Space showed "Traces of Nuba" from 3 to 9 February 2026.

what: Chto Delat wrote in June 2023 that Rosa's House of Culture had been forced to stop its work a year earlier, after it suspended all public programmes when the war escalated in 2022 and its organisers left Saint Petersburg at the end of May 2022.
quote: It has been a year since DK ROSE was forced to cease its work.
